key_difference: (D) implements clearLocalData() as an unconditional d.set(nullptr) with no QThreadData::currentThreadData() guard, so (unlike (B)'s new QThreadStorageData::clear()) it can re-create thread-local storage during shutdown, leaving the guard in qcollator and documenting the new API as shutdown-unsafe, while (B) makes it the one function that is unconditionally safe at shutdown.
